verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Ubuntu Desktop as a general-purpose OS and platform for IDEs/AI-ML tooling, but contains no mention of an official Ubuntu SDK, API, or developer kit that an AI-native user could build against. Probes for docs/API endpoints (llms.txt, openapi.json) all return 404, further indicating no such surface is documented. Missing for 10: any mention of an official Ubuntu SDK/API, developer documentation for building against it, or evidence of a supported SDK ecosystem.
